screen.duollectis.proxy_manager.title: Proxy Manager
screen.duollectis.proxy_manager.msg.edit: Editing — double-click to select, Save to apply.

auto-reconnect.name: Auto Reconnect
auto-reconnect.description: Automatically reconnects to the last server after disconnection.

hide-buttons.name: Hide Buttons
hide-buttons.description: Hides the disconnect screen buttons while waiting.

auto-gap.name: Auto Gap
auto-gap.description: Automatically eats an enchanted golden apple from the hotbar when health drops below the threshold.

min-health.name: Min Health
min-health.description: Health + absorption threshold below which a gap is eaten.

eat-delay.name: Eat Delay
eat-delay.description: Ticks to wait between gap eating attempts.

auto-log.name: Auto Log
auto-log.description: Disconnects from the server when a dangerous condition is detected.

log-mode.name: Log Mode
log-mode.description: Kick — sends a kick packet; Quit — closes the connection directly.

trigger-mode.name: Trigger Mode
trigger-mode.description: What triggers the disconnect: low health, low totem count, or nothing.

health.name: Health
health.description: Health value at or below which the module triggers. Visible only in Health mode.

only-no-totems.name: Only No Totems
only-no-totems.description: Triggers only when no totem of undying is in the inventory. Visible only in Health mode.

totems-count.name: Totems Count
totems-count.description: Triggers when totem count drops to this value or below. Visible only in Totems mode.

toggle-off.name: Toggle Off
toggle-off.description: Disables the module after triggering to prevent repeated disconnects.

ignore-if-naked.name: Ignore If Naked
ignore-if-naked.description: Skips the trigger check when the inventory contains only ignored items.

ignores-items.name: Ignored Items
ignores-items.description: Items that are excluded when checking if the inventory is empty. Visible only when Ignore If Naked is on.

log-messages.name: Log Messages
log-messages.description: Shows a chat message with trigger details on disconnect.

show-nearby-players.name: Show Nearby Players
show-nearby-players.description: Appends a list of nearby players to the disconnect message.

nearby-players-range.name: Nearby Players Range
nearby-players-range.description: Radius in blocks to scan for nearby players. Visible only when Show Nearby Players is on.

ignore-friends.name: Ignore Friends
ignore-friends.description: Excludes friends from the nearby players list.

zombie-duper.name: Zombie Duper
zombie-duper.description: Automates the zombie-based shulker duplication process (for 2k2f.ru).

debug.name: Debug
debug.description: Prints step-by-step debug messages to chat.

chests-range.name: Chests Range
chests-range.description: Radius in blocks to search for chests when stacking or finding nametags.

zombie-range.name: Zombie Range
zombie-range.description: Radius in blocks to consider zombies as part of the dupe setup.

count-range.name: Count Range
count-range.description: Radius in blocks used to count zombies and shulkers around the dupe position.

zombie-trash-range.name: Zombie Trash Range
zombie-trash-range.description: Radius in blocks to check for empty zombies when deciding movement.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Movement speed when repositioning around the dupe spot.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Ticks between each main dupe tick cycle.

drop-per-tick.name: Drop Per Tick
drop-per-tick.description: Number of trash item slots dropped per tick during cleanup.

nametag-amount.name: Nametag Amount
nametag-amount.description: How many nametags to pull from a chest at once.

nametag-slot.name: Nametag Slot
nametag-slot.description: Hotbar slot (1–9) to move nametags into.

refresh-delay.name: Refresh Delay
refresh-delay.description: Ticks to wait before retrying after no chests or nametags are found.

sword-slot.name: Sword Slot
sword-slot.description: Hotbar slot (1–9) to move the sword into when needed.

max-full-slots.name: Max Full Slots
max-full-slots.description: Inventory slot count at which stacking mode activates.

min-shulkers.name: Min Shulkers
min-shulkers.description: Minimum shulker count in inventory before stacking into chests begins.

disable-on-saturday-over.name: Disable On Saturday Over
disable-on-saturday-over.description: Disconnects and disables the module when Saturday ends in Moscow time.

trash-items.name: Trash Items
trash-items.description: Items considered trash and dropped automatically during cleanup.

freecam.name: FreeCam
freecam.description: Detaches the camera from the player, allowing free flight while the player stays frozen on the server.

sensitivity.name: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Mouse sensitivity multiplier for camera rotation.

elytra-fly.name: Elytra Fly
elytra-fly.description: Enhances elytra flight with configurable speed control. Creative mode replaces elytra physics with direct velocity control; Vanilla mode adds a boost impulse on jump.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: CREATIVE — direct velocity control (WASD + jump/sneak); VANILLA — adds a boost impulse on jump press.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Flight speed per tick in Creative mode.

vanilla-boost.name: Vanilla Boost
vanilla-boost.description: Impulse multiplier applied on jump press in Vanilla mode.

auto-activate.name: Auto Activate
auto-activate.description: Automatically starts gliding when the player is airborne and not already gliding.

velocity.name: Velocity
velocity.description: Cancels incoming knockback packets for the local player.

no-world-save.name: No World Save
no-world-save.description: Prevents the singleplayer world from being saved on pause or exit.

auto-totem.name: Auto Totem
auto-totem.description: Automatically moves a Totem of Undying from the inventory into the offhand slot.

swap-delay.name: Swap Delay
swap-delay.description: Ticks between swap attempts. Set to 0 to swap every tick.

mapart-zone-viewer.name: MapArt Zone Viewer
mapart-zone-viewer.description: Renders the active Litematica schematic zone border and warns about snow biomes that can ruin a map art.

border-color.name: Border Color
border-color.description: Color of the schematic zone perimeter lines.

edge-color.name: Edge Marker Color
edge-color.description: Color of the tick marks along zone edges every 16 blocks.

snow-biome-color.name: Snow Biome Color
snow-biome-color.description: Color of vertical markers at snow biome positions.

show-edge-markers.name: Show Edge Markers
show-edge-markers.description: Show tick marks along zone edges every 16 blocks.

warn-snow-biomes.name: Warn Snow Biomes
warn-snow-biomes.description: Print a chat warning when snow biomes are detected inside the schematic zone.

show-map-grid.name: Map Grid
show-map-grid.description: Show the 128×128 map grid around the schematic zone and highlight the nearest aligned position.

map-grid-color.name: Map Grid Color
map-grid-color.description: Color of the 128×128 map grid lines and the target snap position rectangle.

mapart-enhancer.name: MapArt Enhancer
mapart-enhancer.description: Applies bilinear filtering, Gaussian blur and pixel post-processing (brightness, contrast, saturation) to map item textures.

blur.name: Blur
blur.description: Gaussian blur radius in pixels. Hides map pixelation. 0 — no blur, 5 — maximum.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Adjusts the overall brightness of map textures. Positive values brighten, negative darken.

contrast.name: Contrast
contrast.description: Adjusts the contrast of map textures. Positive values increase contrast, negative reduce it.

saturation.name: Saturation
saturation.description: Adjusts the color saturation of map textures. Positive values make colors more vivid, negative desaturate.

custom-fov.name: Custom FOV
custom-fov.description: Overrides the game field of view with a custom value, smoothly interpolated each frame.

fov.name: FOV
fov.description: Target field of view in degrees.

no-view-bob.name: No View Bob
no-view-bob.description: Completely freezes the camera: disables walk bobbing, damage tilt, death rotation, and nausea/potion distortion.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.description: Applies a bloom post-processing effect that makes bright areas glow.

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.description: Brightness threshold above which pixels contribute to the bloom glow (0.0–1.0).

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.description: Multiplier for the bloom glow brightness.

radius.name: Radius
radius.description: Blur radius of the bloom glow in pixels.

render-test.name: Render Test
render-test.description: ESP module for testing world-space render utilities. Draws bounding boxes around players, mobs and entities. Highlights the block under the player's feet and the block under the crosshair.

esp-players.name: ESP Players
esp-players.description: Draws a bounding box around all players in range.

esp-mobs.name: ESP Mobs
esp-mobs.description: Draws a bounding box around all living entities (mobs) in range.

esp-entities.name: ESP Entities
esp-entities.description: Draws a bounding box around all other entities (items, projectiles, etc.) in range.

esp-filled.name: Filled Boxes
esp-filled.description: Renders translucent filled boxes instead of wireframe outlines only.

esp-through-walls.name: Through Walls
esp-through-walls.description: Renders ESP boxes through walls (no depth test).

esp-range.name: Range
esp-range.description: Maximum distance in blocks at which entities are highlighted.

foot-block.name: Foot Block
foot-block.description: Highlights the block directly under the player's feet.

crosshair-block.name: Crosshair Block
crosshair-block.description: Highlights the block currently targeted by the crosshair.

render-test.name: Render Test
render-test.description: Tests all render utilities: world primitives (filled box, lines box) and post-processing effects (vignette, grayscale, chromatic aberration). Displays a HUD overlay with active effect states.

filled-box.name: Filled Box
filled-box.description: Renders a translucent filled AABB around the block at the player's feet.

lines-box.name: Lines Box
lines-box.description: Renders a wireframe box one block above the player's feet.

vignette.name: Vignette
vignette.description: Applies a vignette post-processing effect (darkens screen edges).

vignette-strength.name: Vignette Strength
vignette-strength.description: Controls how strongly the edges are darkened.

grayscale.name: Grayscale
grayscale.description: Applies a grayscale desaturation post-processing effect.

grayscale-strength.name: Grayscale Strength
grayscale-strength.description: Controls how strongly the image is desaturated (0 = none, 1 = full grayscale).

chromatic.name: Chromatic Aberration
chromatic.description: Applies a chromatic aberration post-processing effect.

chromatic-strength.name: Chromatic Strength
chromatic-strength.description: Controls how far the RGB channels are split toward screen edges.

chromatic-aberration.name: Chromatic Aberration
chromatic-aberration.description: Applies a chromatic aberration post-processing effect that splits RGB channels toward screen edges.

strength.name: Strength
strength.description: How far the red and blue channels are shifted from the green channel.

chams.name: Chams
chams.description: Renders a 2D silhouette and outline over entities via the vanilla entityOutlineFramebuffer. Supports multiple shader modes.

affect-mobs.name: Affect Mobs
affect-mobs.description: Applies chams to all living mobs.

shader-mode.name: Shader Mode
shader-mode.description: Visual style of the silhouette fill: FLAT — solid color, RAINBOW — hue-shifting color, PULSE — pulsing transparency, NONE — outline only.

shader-color.name: Shader Color
shader-color.description: Base fill color of the silhouette. Alpha controls transparency. Has no effect in RAINBOW mode.

outline.name: Outline
outline.description: Enables the vanilla 2D outline around the silhouette edges via the entity_outline post-processor.

outline-color.name: Outline Color
outline-color.description: Color of the contour around the 2D silhouette.

hotbar-sorter.name: Hotbar Sorter
hotbar-sorter.description: Automatically fills hotbar slots with items according to configured priority lists. Each slot has its own ordered list — the first item found in the inventory is placed there.

swap-delay.name: Swap Delay
swap-delay.description: Ticks between swap operations. Set to 0 to swap every tick.

slot-1.name: Slot 1 Items
slot-1.description: Priority list for hotbar slot 1. The first item found in the inventory is swapped in.

slot-2.name: Slot 2 Items
slot-2.description: Priority list for hotbar slot 2. The first item found in the inventory is swapped in.

slot-3.name: Slot 3 Items
slot-3.description: Priority list for hotbar slot 3. The first item found in the inventory is swapped in.

slot-4.name: Slot 4 Items
slot-4.description: Priority list for hotbar slot 4. The first item found in the inventory is swapped in.

slot-5.name: Slot 5 Items
slot-5.description: Priority list for hotbar slot 5. The first item found in the inventory is swapped in.

slot-6.name: Slot 6 Items
slot-6.description: Priority list for hotbar slot 6. The first item found in the inventory is swapped in.

slot-7.name: Slot 7 Items
slot-7.description: Priority list for hotbar slot 7. The first item found in the inventory is swapped in.

slot-8.name: Slot 8 Items
slot-8.description: Priority list for hotbar slot 8. The first item found in the inventory is swapped in.

slot-9.name: Slot 9 Items
slot-9.description: Priority list for hotbar slot 9. The first item found in the inventory is swapped in.
